rules.statement: A notary's authority to practice is tied to the judicial district specified in their warrant, and any changes to that district must be addressed through a new application or amendment.
rules.supporting_quote: "If a notary in the situation of the appellant wishes to preserve the area of his original practice, it seems to me that his proper course is to apply to the Governor under section 11 of the Ordinance to 'change the area specified in his warrant, and to grant him a new warrant.'"
